title: United Breaks Guitars
summary: Dave Carroll's song and music video about United Airlines baggage handlers breaking his Taylor guitar and the airline's refusal to compensate him. It became a viral example of a customer fighting a company.
why: Used as the classic example of terrible airline customer service, and of how a viral video can force a company to respond.

quote.text: These guys did eventually get they money after the morning news shows featured thier song.
